Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Industrial Modern Console Table, 47.25"W, Walnut Wood, Metal
Colors: Walnut
Materials: Solid acacia wood top; metal base
This industrial-style console table is a superior multi-tasker. Pull up some stools and use it as a bar for parties, can be a table for eating a quick breakfast or snack, or a work area for your laptop or crafting. 47.25'' W x 15.75''D x 29.5''H Solid acacia wood top; metal base in black finish A compact narrow table great for mutli-tasking Assemble in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
